title: Stranded Compute in AI Inference Workloads: Recovering Value Through Demand Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31654v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI inference infrastructure is commonly analyzed as an energy business. Under full total cost accounting it is not: in the reference deployment modeled here, capital recovery is 87.3% of fully loaded cost per token and electricity 3.7%. Because capital accrues per unit time irrespective of use, accelerator value is destroyed by non-utilization rather than by consumption. Yet, SLO qualified goodput reaches only 59.6% of nameplate throughput, and the decomposition of the loss chain shows that 25.2 of the 40.4 lost percentage points arise from scheduling idleness and stranded burst reserve. Both are properties of a tenant's demand portfolio rather than of its silicon, and neither is diversifiable by a single tenant acting alone. Modelling reserve and idle capacity as diversifiable risk, pooling demand across eight imperfectly correlated tenants (rho = 0.3) recovers 7.3 pp of goodput, approximately $0.75M per annum per megawatt of IT capacit

translated_title: AI推理工作负载中的搁浅算力：通过需求聚合实现价值回收
translated_abstract: AI推理基础设施通常被视为能源业务来分析。但在全成本核算下并非如此：在本文建模的参考部署中，资本回收占每token完全分摊成本的87.3%，而电力仅占3.7%。由于资本按时间累积而与使用与否无关，加速器的价值是被非利用而非消耗所摧毁的。然而，符合SLO要求的有效产出仅达到额定吞吐量的59.6%，对损失链的分解显示40.4个损失百分点中有25.2个百分点源于调度闲置和搁浅的突发预留容量。这两者都是租户需求组合的属性而非其芯片的属性，且均无法由单个租户独立行动来分散。通过将预留和闲置容量建模为可分散的风险，在八个相关性不完美的租户（rho = 0.3）之间聚合需求，可以回收7.3个百分点的有效产出，相当于每兆瓦IT容量每年约75万美元。
tldr: 本文指出AI推理成本中资本回收占87.3%而电力仅3.7%，其价值损失主要源于调度闲置和搁浅的突发预留，通过在多个不完全相关的租户间聚合需求可回收7.3个百分点的有效产出，相当于每兆瓦IT容量每年约75万美元。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that capital recovery accounts for 87.3% of AI inference costs versus only 3.7% for electricity, and by modeling scheduling idleness and stranded burst reserve as diversifiable risk, demand aggregation across eight imperfectly correlated tenants recovers 7.3 percentage points of goodput, worth approximately $0.75M annually per megawatt of IT capacity.
